notes: Gaps for the owner: (1) Rollback once v2 emits the new categories: a pending review checkpointed with e.g. cash_deposit or director_funding cannot be validated by the previous release; langgraph's serde then falls back to model_construct and keeps a raw string category without raising. The task that lands the v2 rules should either document 'finish or discard pending reviews before downgrading' or make the CMA_RULESET=v1 flag the rollback path (the design already names it). Not fixable in T02 without design. (2) account_key is an unconstrained str; the case-store task should validate it (e.g. a slug) when importers start setting it. (3) The SQLite resume contract test needs the 'durable' extra. CI installs it, but the 'llm' extra is not in CI's install line, so 'all extras' in CI means dev,mcp,durable. (4) mcp_server.compute_metrics docstring still says M1..M16; that is for the task that adds M17-M28. (5) The design names no CHANGELOG, so no release-note line was written; the owner should decide whether one is wanted.
